'''Aleksandra Halina Lelywa-Kupistynska''' (August 20, 1937 in [[Warsaw]] - March 18, 2023) was a Polish physicist, professor at the [[University of Warsaw]]. In 2018–2022, she was President of the Society for Children of the Holocaust (SDH).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Aleksandra Leliwa-Kopystyńska, Warszawa, 22.03.2023 - kondolencje |url=https://nekrologi.wyborcza.pl/0,11,,557423,Aleksandra-Leliwa-Kopysty%C5%84ska-kondolencje.html |access-date=2024-01-16 |website=nekrologi.wyborcza.pl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Nowa Nauka Polska |url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=71889&_k=9q7x1s |access-date=2024-01-16 |website=nauka-polska.pl}}</ref>

== Life ==
[[File:Aleksandra Leliwa-Kopystyńska grave.jpg|thumb|260x260px|The grave of Aleksandra Lewa-Kupistyńska at the Powązki Military Cemetery in Warsaw]]
Aleksandra Halina Lelywa-Kupistynska was born into a Polish-Jewish family, the daughter of Józef Smitanowski, a sergeant in the [[Polish Armed Forces|Polish army]] who received the [[Cross of Independence]] in 1942, and Irena Nye Wakenbaum. She survived [[World War II]] along with his mother and older brother Stephen.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Zarządzenie o nadaniu Krzyża Niepodległości z Mieczami, Krzyża Niepodległości i Medalu Niepodległości (M.P. z 1937 r. nr 259, poz. 409).}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-11-24 |title=Spotkanie ze świadkiem historii: Aleksandra Leliwa-Kopystyńska {{!}} Muzeum Historii Żydów Polskich POLIN w Warszawie |url=https://www.polin.pl/pl/wydarzenie/spotkanie-ze-swiadkiem-historii-aleksandra-leliwa-kopystynska |access-date=2024-01-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201124160414/https://www.polin.pl/pl/wydarzenie/spotkanie-ze-swiadkiem-historii-aleksandra-leliwa-kopystynska |archive-date=2020-11-24 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Historia pomocy - Rodzina Paców {{!}} Polscy Sprawiedliwi |url=https://sprawiedliwi.org.pl/pl/historie-pomocy/historia-pomocy-rodzina-pacow |access-date=2024-01-16 |website=sprawiedliwi.org.pl}}</ref>

Lelywa-Kupistynska specialized in [[experimental physics|experimental]]  [[atomic physics]], and [[atomic spectroscopy|atomic]] and molecular [[spectroscopy]]. She was a researcher at the Institute of Experimental Physics for many years and was also a member of the Polish Physics Society, serving as its Secretary General in 2002–2003. She initiated the creation of the Women's Division of the PTF and served as the Chairman of its Audit Committee. She was also a member of the Children of the Holocaust Association, serving as vice president from 2009 and President from 2018 to 2022. She was a member of the Social College [[POLIN Museum of the History of Polish Jews]] in Warsaw.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2012-03-24 |title=INFORMACJE OGOLNE O POLSKIM TOWARZYSTWIE FIZYCZNYM |url=http://ptf.fuw.edu.pl/ptf2p2002.html |access-date=2024-01-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120324055616/http://ptf.fuw.edu.pl/ptf2p2002.html |archive-date=2012-03-24 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-06-26 |title=Stowarzyszenie Dzieci Holocaustu |url=http://www.dzieciholocaustu.org.pl/szab3.php?s=ostowarzyszeniu.php |access-date=2024-01-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180626121934/http://www.dzieciholocaustu.org.pl/szab3.php?s=ostowarzyszeniu.php |archive-date=2018-06-26 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=STOWARZYSZENIE DZIECI HOLOCAUSTU W POLSCE {{!}} Rejestr.io |url=https://rejestr.io/krs/97668/stowarzyszenie-dzieci-holocaustu-w-polsce |access-date=2024-01-16 |website=rejestr.io}}</ref>
